project.name: microservices-demo
project.description: Online Boutique is a cloud-first microservices e-commerce demo application by Google, featuring 11 microservices that communicate over gRPC. Users can browse products, add them to a cart, and complete purchases with simulated payment processing, shipping, and email confirmation.

nodes.name: Product Catalog
nodes.summary: Manages the product inventory including listing, searching, and retrieving individual product details. Serves as one of the most depended-upon services, referenced by the frontend, checkout, and recommendation services.

businessRules: Products loaded from JSON file or AlloyDB
Search matches against product names and descriptions
Returns NOT_FOUND for missing product IDs
crossDomainInteractions: Checkout service retrieves product prices during order placement
Recommendation service queries full catalog to generate suggestions
Frontend fetches product listings and details for display

nodes.name: Shopping Cart
nodes.summary: Handles cart state management for users, supporting adding items, retrieving cart contents, and emptying the cart. Supports multiple storage backends (Redis, Spanner, AlloyDB) via a strategy pattern.

businessRules: Cart items identified by user session ID and product ID
Quantity constraints enforced (1-10 per add)
Cart emptied after successful checkout
crossDomainInteractions: Frontend adds/removes items and displays cart
Checkout service retrieves cart contents during order placement

nodes.name: Checkout and Ordering
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the entire purchase flow by coordinating six downstream microservices: cart retrieval, product lookup, currency conversion, shipping calculation, payment charging, and email confirmation. This is the most complex business logic in the system.

businessRules: All downstream calls must succeed for order to complete
Cart is emptied after successful order
Shipping cost and item prices converted to user's preferred currency
crossDomainInteractions: Calls cart service to retrieve items
Calls product catalog for prices
Calls currency service for conversion
Calls shipping service for quote
Calls payment service to charge
Calls email service for confirmation

nodes.name: Payment Processing
nodes.summary: Provides simulated credit card payment processing. Validates card numbers (VISA/MasterCard only), checks expiration dates, and returns a UUID transaction ID for successful charges.

businessRules: Only VISA and MasterCard numbers accepted
Card expiration date must be in the future
Returns UUID transaction ID on success
crossDomainInteractions: Called by checkout service during order placement

nodes.name: Shipping
nodes.summary: Calculates shipping quotes based on item count and simulates order shipment by generating tracking IDs. Uses a flat-rate pricing model ($8.99 for any non-empty order).

businessRules: Flat $8.99 shipping for any non-zero item count
$0 shipping for empty orders
Tracking ID generated from address hash with random components
crossDomainInteractions: Called by checkout service for shipping cost and shipment
Called by frontend to display shipping estimate in cart view

nodes.name: Currency Conversion
nodes.summary: Converts monetary amounts between supported currencies using exchange rate data. Normalizes all conversions through EUR as an intermediate currency.

businessRules: All conversions normalize through EUR first
Supports listing all available currencies
Proper handling of nanos overflow in money arithmetic
crossDomainInteractions: Called by frontend to display prices in user's preferred currency
Called by checkout service during order total calculation

nodes.name: Email Notifications
nodes.summary: Sends order confirmation emails using Jinja2 HTML templates. Supports a dummy mode for development that logs confirmation details instead of sending real emails.

businessRules: Renders order confirmation using Jinja2 templates
DummyEmailService logs instead of sending in development
Cloud mail client for production (currently unimplemented)
crossDomainInteractions: Called by checkout service after successful payment

nodes.name: Recommendations
nodes.summary: Provides product recommendations by querying the full product catalog, filtering out items the user has already viewed, and returning a random sample of up to 5 alternatives.

businessRules: Excludes products the user has already viewed
Returns up to 5 random product recommendations
Read-only service that does not modify state
crossDomainInteractions: Queries product catalog service for full product list
Called by frontend for home page and product detail page suggestions

nodes.name: Advertising
nodes.summary: Serves contextual advertisements based on product category keys. Maintains an in-memory map of category-to-ad mappings and falls back to random ads when no category match is found.

businessRules: Ads matched by product category context keys
Falls back to random ads if no category match
Hardcoded ad entries for known product categories
crossDomainInteractions: Called by frontend to display ads on home and product pages

nodes.name: Shopping Assistant
nodes.summary: AI-powered shopping assistant implementing a RAG pipeline that uses Gemini vision to analyze room images, performs vector similarity search against product embeddings in AlloyDB, and returns interior design product recommendations.

businessRules: Three-step RAG pipeline: image analysis, vector search, response generation
Uses Gemini vision model for room image analysis
Vector similarity search on AlloyDB product embeddings
crossDomainInteractions: Called by frontend chatbot handler
Queries AlloyDB for product embeddings

nodes.name: Browse Products
nodes.summary: User browses the product catalog on the home page, viewing product listings with prices converted to their preferred currency, along with contextual ads.

nodes.name: View Product Details
nodes.summary: User views a specific product's detail page including price in preferred currency, product recommendations, contextual ads, and optionally interacts with the AI shopping assistant.

nodes.name: Manage Shopping Cart
nodes.summary: User adds products to their cart, views cart contents with resolved product details and shipping estimates, and can empty the cart.

nodes.name: Checkout and Purchase
nodes.summary: User submits payment and shipping information to complete a purchase. The checkout service orchestrates cart retrieval, price lookup, currency conversion, shipping calculation, payment charging, cart emptying, and email confirmation.

nodes.name: Set Currency Preference
nodes.summary: User selects a preferred display currency which is stored as a cookie and applied to all subsequent price displays across the application.

nodes.name: Get Product Recommendations
nodes.summary: Recommendation service fetches the full product catalog, excludes already-viewed products, and returns a random sample of up to 5 suggestions displayed on home and product pages.

nodes.name: Serve Contextual Ads
nodes.summary: Ad service receives context keys from the frontend and returns matching advertisements for product categories, falling back to random ads when no match exists.

nodes.name: Convert Currency
nodes.summary: Currency service converts monetary amounts between currencies by normalizing through EUR, supporting both individual conversions and listing all supported currencies.

nodes.name: Send Order Confirmation Email
nodes.summary: Email service renders an order confirmation using Jinja2 templates and sends it to the customer (or logs it in development mode).

nodes.name: AI Shopping Assistant Chat
nodes.summary: User interacts with a chatbot that analyzes room images via Gemini vision, searches product embeddings for matching items, and returns interior design recommendations.

nodes.name: Calculate Shipping Quote
nodes.summary: Shipping service calculates a flat-rate shipping quote based on item count and generates tracking IDs for shipped orders.

nodes.name: Process Payment
nodes.summary: Payment service validates credit card details (number format, expiration), and returns a transaction ID for the simulated charge.

nodes.name: Fetch Product List
nodes.summary: Frontend calls ProductCatalogService.ListProducts to retrieve all available products.

nodes.name: Fetch Supported Currencies
nodes.summary: Frontend calls CurrencyService.GetSupportedCurrencies to populate the currency selector dropdown.

nodes.name: Convert Product Prices
nodes.summary: Frontend converts each product price to the user's preferred currency via CurrencyService.Convert.

nodes.name: Fetch Cart Item Count
nodes.summary: Frontend retrieves the user's cart to display the item count badge in the navigation bar.

nodes.name: Fetch Contextual Ads
nodes.summary: Frontend calls AdService.GetAds to retrieve advertisements displayed on the home page.

nodes.name: Render Home Page
nodes.summary: Frontend assembles all fetched data and renders the home page HTML template with products, prices, cart count, and ads.

nodes.name: Fetch Product by ID
nodes.summary: Frontend calls ProductCatalogService.GetProduct to retrieve the specific product details.

nodes.name: Convert Product Price
nodes.summary: Frontend converts the product price to the user's preferred currency.

nodes.name: Fetch Recommendations
nodes.summary: Frontend calls RecommendationService.ListRecommendations to get suggested products, then resolves each to full product details.

nodes.name: Fetch Product Ads
nodes.summary: Frontend calls AdService.GetAds with the product's category keys for contextual advertisements.

nodes.name: Render Product Detail Page
nodes.summary: Frontend assembles product info, converted price, recommendations, and ads into the product detail template.

nodes.name: Validate Add-to-Cart Input
nodes.summary: Frontend validates the product ID and quantity (1-10 range) from the add-to-cart form submission.

nodes.name: Add Item to Cart
nodes.summary: Frontend calls CartService.AddItem with the user's session ID, product ID, and quantity.

nodes.name: Retrieve Cart Contents
nodes.summary: Frontend calls CartService.GetCart to load all items in the user's cart with their quantities.

nodes.name: Resolve Product Details for Cart Items
nodes.summary: Frontend calls ProductCatalogService.GetProduct for each cart item to get names, descriptions, and prices.

nodes.name: Convert Cart Prices
nodes.summary: Frontend converts each cart item's price and the total to the user's preferred currency.

nodes.name: Get Shipping Estimate
nodes.summary: Frontend calls ShippingService.GetQuote to display the estimated shipping cost in the cart view.

nodes.name: Render Cart View
nodes.summary: Frontend renders the cart page with item details, converted prices, shipping estimate, and order total.

nodes.name: Validate Checkout Input
nodes.summary: Frontend validates email, shipping address, and credit card fields from the checkout form.

nodes.name: Retrieve Cart Items
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls CartService.GetCart to get all items in the user's cart.

nodes.name: Look Up Product Prices
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls ProductCatalogService.GetProduct for each cart item to get current prices.

nodes.name: Get Shipping Quote
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls ShippingService.GetQuote to calculate the shipping cost for the order.

nodes.name: Convert to User Currency
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls CurrencyService.Convert to convert all amounts to the user's preferred currency.

nodes.name: Charge Credit Card
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls PaymentService.Charge with the total amount and credit card details.

nodes.name: Ship Order
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls ShippingService.ShipOrder to get a tracking ID for the order.

nodes.name: Empty Cart After Purchase
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls CartService.EmptyCart to clear the user's cart after successful payment.

nodes.name: Send Order Confirmation
nodes.summary: Checkout service calls EmailService.SendOrderConfirmation with the order details and customer email.

nodes.name: Render Order Confirmation Page
nodes.summary: Frontend renders the order confirmation page with order ID, tracking ID, and order summary.

nodes.name: Select Currency
nodes.summary: User selects a currency from the dropdown populated by GetSupportedCurrencies.

nodes.name: Store Currency Cookie
nodes.summary: Frontend sets a cookie with the selected currency code and redirects back to the referring page.

nodes.name: Fetch Full Product Catalog
nodes.summary: Recommendation service calls ProductCatalogService.ListProducts to get all available products.

nodes.name: Filter Already-Viewed Products
nodes.summary: Recommendation service removes products the user has already viewed from the candidate set.

nodes.name: Sample Random Recommendations
nodes.summary: Recommendation service randomly selects up to 5 products from the filtered set as recommendations.

nodes.name: Look Up Ads by Category
nodes.summary: Ad service searches its in-memory map for ads matching the provided context category keys.

nodes.name: Fallback to Random Ads
nodes.summary: If no category match is found, the ad service returns randomly selected ads from the full pool.

nodes.name: Normalize to EUR
nodes.summary: Currency service converts the source amount to EUR using the source currency's exchange rate.

nodes.name: Convert EUR to Target Currency
nodes.summary: Currency service applies the target currency's exchange rate to the EUR-normalized amount.

nodes.name: Render Email Template
nodes.summary: Email service renders the order confirmation HTML using Jinja2 templates with order details.

nodes.name: Send or Log Confirmation
nodes.summary: Email service sends the rendered email via cloud mail client (production) or logs it (development).

nodes.name: Analyze Room Image with Gemini
nodes.summary: Shopping assistant sends the user's room image to the Gemini vision model for interior design analysis.

nodes.name: Search Product Embeddings
nodes.summary: Shopping assistant performs vector similarity search against product embeddings stored in AlloyDB.

nodes.name: Generate Recommendation Response
nodes.summary: Shopping assistant uses Gemini to generate a natural language response with product recommendations based on the analysis and search results.

nodes.name: Count Total Items
nodes.summary: Shipping service counts the total number of items in the shipping request.

nodes.name: Calculate Flat-Rate Quote
nodes.summary: Shipping service returns $8.99 for non-empty orders or $0 for empty orders via CreateQuoteFromCount.

nodes.name: Generate Tracking ID
nodes.summary: Shipping service generates a tracking ID from address data and random components for shipped orders.

nodes.name: Validate Credit Card
nodes.summary: Payment service validates the card number format (VISA/MasterCard) and checks the expiration date.

nodes.name: Generate Transaction ID
nodes.summary: Payment service generates a UUID transaction ID representing the successful simulated charge.

edges.description: Checkout retrieves cart items and empties cart after purchase
Checkout looks up product prices for each cart item
Checkout converts order amounts to user's preferred currency
Checkout requests shipping quote and initiates shipment
Checkout charges the customer's credit card via payment service
Checkout sends order confirmation email after successful payment
Recommendation service queries full product catalog to generate suggestions
Frontend converts product prices to user's preferred currency when displaying catalog
Cart view resolves product details for each cart item
Cart view displays shipping cost estimate
